player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Mastermind.
You need to find the code that is {code_length} digits long, each digit from 1 to {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
In your response, you can submit your guess in the following format: '[2 1 4 5]'.
After each guess, you will receive feedback in the form of black and white pegs.
A black peg indicates a correct digit in the correct position, while a white peg indicates a correct digit in the wrong position.
You have {max_turns} turns to guess the code.

invalid_move.wrong_format: သူဢမ်ႇတွပ်ႇၶိုၼ်းလူၺ်ႈ သဵၼ်ႈမၢႆ ဢၼ်ၽႄဝႆႉတီႈ space သေ ဢဝ်တူဝ်ၼပ်ႉဢၼ်ပႃးၼႂ်း square bracket ၼၼ်ႉ။
invalid_move.not_integers: လွင်ႈၶဝ်ႈပႃးတင်းမူတ်းၼႆႉ တေလႆႈပဵၼ် တူဝ်ၼပ်ႉတဵမ် ဢၼ်ထုၵ်ႇမႅၼ်ႈၸွမ်း။
invalid_move.wrong_length: လွင်ႈလၢမ်းၶၢတ်ႈၼၼ်ႉ ထုၵ်ႇလီပႃးဝႆႉ တူဝ်ၼပ်ႉ {code_length} ဢၼ်ၼိူင်ႈၼၼ်ႉယဝ်ႉ။
invalid_move.out_of_range: တူဝ်ၼပ်ႉတင်းမူတ်းၼႆႉ တေလႆႈမီးၼႂ်းၵႄႈ 1 လႄႈ {num_numbers} ၼၼ်ႉယဝ်ႉ။
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: မၢႆဢၼ်မိူၼ်ၵၼ်ၼၼ်ႉ ဢမ်ႇလႆႈၶႂၢင်းပၼ်။
invalid_move.repeated_guess: You have already guessed {guess}. Please try a different guess.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: You have cracked the code, solving {black_pegs} out of {code_length} pegs correctly
outcome.turn_limit: လွင်ႈၶၢႆႉတီႈသုတ်းၼႆႉ ႁွတ်ႈထိုင်ဝႆႉယဝ်ႉ။ သူၸၢင်ႊထၢင်ႇဝႃႈ မၢႆၼပ်ႉဢၼ်ထုၵ်ႇမႅၼ်ႈၼၼ်ႉ ပဵၼ် {percent} ႁူဝ်ပၢၵ်ႇၼၼ်ႉယဝ်ႉ။
